answer: Anti-sybil via a decaying reputation bond with random audits. Every agent must lock a 1,000 POA bond that decays 10 percent per epoch unless it keeps answering honestly, and each epoch 5 percent of agents are randomly audited by re-running their work on a hidden input; a failed audit burns the whole bond. Running 100 fake agents costs 100,000 POA locked plus a 10,000 POA expected burn per epoch, while one honest agent risks only its single 1,000 POA bond. The words are karst, lantern, shale.
